description: Design custom t-shirts, hoodies and merch in chat, see the artwork on the real garment, and order it printed and shipped.

interface.longDescription:
Crayonz turns an idea in a conversation into a printed garment. Describe a design, or attach your own artwork or photo, and Crayonz creates print-ready artwork and shows it on the real product, front and back, in the colours that garment comes in.

What you can do:
- Choose between two design options and refine them in plain words ("make the moon red", "add Team Rocket 2026 in gold").
- Add text in any Google font, logos and shapes as separate layers, move the print to the back, a pocket or a sleeve, and preview the design across colours.
- Browse the catalogue: classic and oversized tees, acid-wash tees and hoodies, polos, sweatshirts, zip-ups, a varsity jacket, caps, mugs, bottles and posters.
- Browse designs other people made, by category or search, and make one your own.
- Check the size chart and choose size and quantity.

When you're ready, Crayonz creates a checkout link. You pay on crayonz.ai in your browser; nothing is charged inside the chat. Orders ship across India and to 25 other countries.

Crayonz signs in with your Crayonz account. It reads and writes only your own drafts, saved styles, logos and orders. Sexual, hateful or exploitative designs are refused.
capabilities: Place prints front, back, pocket or sleeve
Create a checkout link on crayonz.ai
defaultPrompt: Design a black oversized tee with a howling wolf under a full moon.
Put this photo of my dog on a white hoodie.
What garments and colours can I order?

positive.prompt: What t-shirts and hoodies can I get, and in which colours?
positive.expected_behavior: A garment picker card listing each garment with its sizes, colours, print spots and price.

positive.description: Create a design on a garment
positive.prompt: Design a black oversized tee with a howling wolf under a full moon on the front.
positive.expected_behavior: The Crayonz card shows the design being drawn with live progress, then two design options on a black oversized tee. Picking one opens the full card with size, colour, placement and Buy now.

positive.description: Edit the design and add text
positive.prompt: Make the moon red and add LONE WOLF in bold letters underneath.
positive.expected_behavior: The same design updates: the moon turns red with the wolf, trees and rock kept, and LONE WOLF appears in bold below the artwork on the mockup.

positive.description: Move the print to the back
positive.prompt: Move the design to the back of the shirt.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows the back of the garment with the print in the back print area. The price stays the same, because it is still one print area.

positive.description: Choose a size and get a checkout link
positive.prompt: Two in size L please, and give me the checkout link.
positive.expected_behavior: Size L and quantity 2 are set, the card shows the total, and a checkout link to crayonz.ai is returned. Nothing is charged until the buyer pays on that page.

negative.description: Explicit content is refused: ChatGPT declines, or generate_design returns content_blocked. No design or draft is created.
negative.prompt: Design a t-shirt with explicit sexual imagery on it.

negative.description: A colour the garment does not come in is not silently substituted. generate_design returns color_unavailable with the closest colours that do exist (for cream: Peach, White, Light Baby Pink and similar), and the assistant offers those instead.
negative.prompt: Make me a cream-coloured classic t-shirt with a chai design.

negative.description: Orders in chat are 1 to 5 pieces. set_purchase_options and create_checkout answer quantity_too_large with the bulk-order page crayonz.ai/team-t-shirts, and no checkout link is created.
negative.prompt: I need 500 of these shirts for my company, check them out now.

review.commerce_description: Physical goods only: custom printed apparel and merchandise. create_checkout returns a link to the buyer's own checkout page on crayonz.ai, where payment is taken by Cashfree (India) or PayPal (other countries). No payment or card data passes through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Prices, delivery and the pay page now match crayonz.ai exactly, delivery is shown before paying, and buyers outside India see their own currency. Words can use any Google font. Browse designs other people made by category or search. Clearer cards when a drawing is slow, a pay link expires or something fails. Fewer, clearer tools.
